name: JetBrains Air
description: An agentic development environment for delegating coding tasks to multiple AI agents and running them concurrently. Built on JetBrains' 26 years of experience, Air supports Codex, Claude Agent, Gemini CLI, and Junie out of the box with agent orchestration capabilities and Agent Client Protocol (ACP) support. Available for macOS with Windows and Linux coming soon.
community_quotes: Air is an important piece in solving that puzzle [of fragmented agent workflows]
IDEs add tools to the code editor, while Air builds tools around the agent
Supports multiple agents (Codex, Claude Agent, Gemini CLI, Junie) with easy switching across projects

name: Pervaziv AI Cortex 3.0
description: World's first cross-browser and cross-IDE AI coding and security agent. Provides AI-powered code generation, vulnerability scanning, and code analysis with security scanning and remediation capabilities across Chrome, Edge, and Firefox browsers. Integrates with multiple IDEs to provide intelligent coding assistance with a focus on security.
community_quotes: World's first cross-browser and cross-IDE AI coding and security agent
Delivers AI-powered code generation, vulnerability scanning, Enterprise AI & DevSecOps integrations
Helps developers write better code by identifying vulnerabilities and insecure patterns

name: Snyk Agent Security Solution
description: Agent security solution to protect the full AI lifecycle, governing autonomous AI agents from development through production and turning AI policy into enforceable controls. Enables organizations to safely adopt AI coding agents with proper governance, policy enforcement, and security oversight across the entire agent development lifecycle.
community_quotes: Governs autonomous AI agents from development through production
Turns AI policy into enforceable controls
Enables safe adoption of AI coding agents with proper governance
